name: Hummus Veggie Burger with Tomato, Olive & Romaine Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
3 red bell peppers
3 hearts romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 8-10 minutes (or cook patties according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 veggie burger patties, plant-based

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice half of the tomatoes and place on a large plate; season with salt. Medium dice remaining tomatoes and place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the tomato.
Separate lettuce into leaves. Set aside one leaf per burger, adding them to the plate with the sliced tomato. Chop (or tear) remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl, along with the vinaigrette, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
⅓ cup balsamic vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Spread top and bottom halves of each bun with hummus. Layer the bottom halves with lettuce, tomato, and burger patties, then close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
